consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the June 17, 1976 show at the Capitol Theatre features a strong performance with excellent sound quality. While many praise the energy and mix of the setlist, some reviewers note a lack of tempo and energy in certain songs.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 18 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and sound quality, there were notable criticisms regarding the energy and tempo of some songs, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
